body:
Two offline clones can both mint the same T-n; after a pull-merge both files can survive (e.g. in different state dirs). fsck correctly flags "duplicate issue record id" but nothing tells the user how to recover.

Fix: add a short documented procedure (README, near the sync section): pick the survivor, rename the other file + its record id to a fresh T-n, fix any deps pointing at it, move its events file alongside, commit. Resolution TOOLING is out of scope per non-goals — this is a docs-only ticket.
title: Document recovery procedure for duplicate ticket IDs after merge
